arguments.message: Hi! The single export from the dashboard is capped at 10,000 rows. For larger datasets you can either narrow the date range or add filters so each export stays under the cap, or run multiple exports (e.g., one per month). If you need a full, uncapped history regularly, set up a scheduled export to cloud storage – that export isn’t limited to 10,000 rows. Let me know if you’d like help setting that up!
